listing.name: Meme Royale
listing.kind: battle royale — 50 players, solo and trios, in the browser
listing.blurb: A 50-player battle royale that runs in your browser. Drop onto the island, loot chests, and be the last one standing while the storm closes in. Play solo or in trios; bots fill any empty seats.
listing.about: Meme Royale is a fork of Max Blade's Kong Royale (MIT): a three.js client and a Node server that run the same simulation, with the server deciding every hit, pickup and storm tick. You play as Triple T. There's a firing range with every gun, bot matches that run entirely in your browser, and private lobbies with friends. Sign in with Elo Pros to play as your account; your callsign stays yours.

made_with.note: Built with AI coding agents (Kong Royale before it, and Claude on this fork); Triple T was modelled with Meshy
